Bulletin No: 05 MWW/2026/07/31/01
COLOR: Red
Warning for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 11.00 a.m. 31 July 2026
Valid for the period until 11.00 a.m. 01 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar and from Hambantota to Pottuvil.
TAKE ACTION!
The sea areas off the coasts extending from
Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via Mannar and
from Hambantota to Pottuvil will be very
rough at times with strong gusty winds up to
(60-70) kmph. Naval and fishing
communities are advised not to venture into
these sea areas, until further notice.
The sea areas off the coasts extending from
Trincomalee to Kankasanthurai via
Mullaittivu and Kalpitiya to Hambantota Via
Colombo, and Galle will be rough at times
with strong gusty winds up to (50-60) kmph.
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 2.5) meters in the sea areas off the
coast extending from Mannar to Pottuvil via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be attentive to future forecasts
issued by the Department of Meteorology in
this regard.
